_comment: RAG retrieval golden set — queries grounded in the user's real repos (ai-applications, tucaken-app, tucaken-infra, kubernetes-bootstrap, frontend-portfolio) + JD requirements. `expectedRepos`/`expectedFiles` drive deterministic recall@k; the LLM judge scores context-relevance per retrieved chunk. `kind:'negative'` queries SHOULD score low relevance (honest-gap signal). v2: repo names re-keyed cdk-monitoring→tucaken-infra (post-rename sources never matched, recall pinned at 0); stripe moved positive (tucaken-app billing is real); +18 fact-grounded queries hand-labelled from known decisions/incidents/runbooks so extraction recall is measured against ground truth, not topic guesses. Refine freely; versioned so regressions are visible.
